en: The postcard features a religious statue of the Virgin Mary, specifically 'Virgen de los Dolores,' dressed in ornate, embroidered robes with a golden halo around her head. She is depicted holding a flaming heart pierced by swords, a common Catholic iconography representing sorrow. The background is plain, focusing attention entirely on the religious figure. At the bottom, there is Spanish text indicating the veneration of this figure in a specific church.
